Description
This 500 gram gold bar is made to the highest quality standards by Valcambi Suisse, renowned Swiss precious metal refiners. They are made with precision and elegance.
Valcambi Suisse
was founded in 1961 as Valori & Cambi in Balerna. Credit Suisse purchased the refinery, after it was struggling in its first year The acquisition resulted from the merging of Valori & Cambi in  Valcambi and the addition of Suisse to its name.  While Credit Suisse no longer holds a stake in Valcambi Suisse’s business, it retains the internationally recognized brand name,
The Valcambi 500 gram gold bars are a favourite among investors as they contain full of 500g, or half a kilogram(16.075 troy oz) of .9999(24 carat) fine gold and are cast using traditional methods.
